title: The project service is missing or out of date
summary: If Station cannot reach the project service, or the service is an older version, restart Station so it starts the current one.
alternateQueries: Why will my project not open?
Why does it ask for the storage folder again?

blocks.title: "the project service is not running" or it stopped answering
blocks.resolution: Station starts the project service by itself when it needs it. Close Station, then start it again. The service also closes itself after an hour of inactivity; the next start brings it back.

blocks.title: The service is out of date
symptoms: cannot send or take large files
blocks.resolution: Close Djehuti Station and its project service (DjehutiSuiteVfsService.exe in Task Manager), then start Station again.

blocks.title: The storage folder prompt appears again
symptoms: asked where to keep data on every start
blocks.resolution: The storage location is recorded in one small file (suite-settings.json in your Roaming application data, Djehuti-Suite folder). If that file is missing you are asked again; choose the same folder to use your existing projects.
